caption: The drawing is done in pencil on a light beige or off-white paper. It depicts two objects: a wine glass drawn from the side (profile) view situated in the top half of the image, and a circular shape representing the base of the glass drawn from above (top view) in the lower half of the image. The wine glass has a broad, slightly flared bowl with gentle shading that suggests transparency and curvature, a narrow stem, and a circular, flat base. Directly below the base of the wine glass, there is a simple outline drawing of a circle with a smaller concentric circle at its center, indicating the top view of the glass’s base. There are vertical dashed lines connecting the profile and top views for alignment reference. The lines used are delicate, and the overall style is technical and precise, focusing on the structure and proportions of the glass.
title: Wine Glass
